cases.name: preview required; migration atomic, idempotent and legacy unchanged
abort each migration store leaves no completion marker or partial rows
malformed and inaccessible legacy data never becomes an empty migration
old writer freezes new mutations; both versions remain exportable across reopen
failed recovery copy preserves raw data and freezes this client
epoch replacement rejects queued and retried jobs, including same cook IDs
missed old-writer event is detected at reopen
versionchange closes connection; blocked open reports recovery
old write during mutation cannot publish unqualified success
real second-tab stale mutation rejected after replacement
atomic sample identity, manual spots and live watermarks
binding intervals, exclusive food ownership and old jobs after replacement
aborted append keeps readings and summaries unchanged; end rejects late samples
real normalization/store/recorder burst persists each accepted sample
end cannot precede a sample that committed in another transaction
delete is atomic and a retired cook identity cannot receive queued work
storage access loss freezes discovery status but committed history stays exportable

limitations: Isolated Chromium origin and synthetic data; no native Safari, physical hardware, PWA upgrade, or unattended duration proof.
